_note: Households that no member of the direct line belongs to, but that a record of this archive ties to the line as kin. Each entry carries the record that does it. Everything else in households.json that does not hold a member of the line is unjoined (see /wider-family). The same households are listed under «The line» on /which-falco.

households.why: Giuseppe Falco is a son of Matteo Falco and Francesca Crisci: the parish baptism calls him «filium Matthei, e Franciscae Crisci», and the civil acts of 1810 and 1811 write him «del fu Matteo». A brother of generation two.
Gioacchino Falco is a son of Matteo Falco and Francesca Crisci: the index to the Arienzo deaths of 1851 names his parents so. Also a brother of generation two.

Francescantonio Falco, son of Pasquale Falco and Chiara Rivetti (generation two), married Raffaela Falco, daughter of Giuseppe Falco and Antonia di Guida, in 1832. Their children are grandchildren of Matteo Falco through both of his sons.
Pasquale Falco is the son of Francesco Falco and Raffaela Falco: his death act of 26 September 1883 names his parents, which places him in the household above.

On 4 May 1831 the clerk of the Arienzo death register recorded Vincenzo Falco of this line as «parente della defunta» at the death of Michelangelo's thirteen-month-old daughter Anna. The degree is not stated.
